lines.text: AI agents can now do real data work.
But would you hand one the keys to your health data? What can it see? What can it change?
With the Open Hexa MCP connector, bring the agent you already use. Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini... with governance built in.
You choose exactly which workspaces it can reach, which resources it can use, and whether it can only read, or also write.
It acts with your permissions, never more. If you can't open a workspace, neither can your agent. And connection secrets stay out of reach.
Then it gets real work done. Exploring datasets, building pipelines, publishing web apps. Every call is logged, and every result is code you can read.
Change your mind? Narrow or revoke access at any time. It applies on the very next call.
Open Hexa. Bring your agents. Keep control.
